_banner: SYNTHETIC DATA / SIMULATED OPERATION / NOT PRODUCTION DEPLOYED. Metric definitions for the NASHA analytics mart. 'owner' is a ROLE in a hypothetical operation, not a real person. Every value is computed from synthetic data; none is a business result.

metrics.name: orders
metrics.label: Orders
caveats: Excludes orders quarantined by the lab validation step (duplicates, malformed timestamps, future timestamps, ...).
Synthetic orders; NASHA has no customers.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, COUNT(*) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT location_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM src_fact_order GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: gross_sales_usd
metrics.label: Gross sales (USD)
caveats: Prices are PLACEHOLDER inputs from the lab generator, not NASHA prices.
No returns, discounts, comps, tax or tips exist in the data, so gross = net here; do not read it as net revenue of a real business.
Price-drift lines flagged WARN stay in (only ERROR severity is quarantined).
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, SUM(l.gross_sales_cents)/100.0 FROM fact_order_line l JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT o.location_id, SUM(l.qty*l.unit_price_cents)/100.0 FROM src_fact_order_line l JOIN src_fact_order o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: units_sold
metrics.label: Units sold
caveats: Counts every menu item (food, beer, non-alcoholic) equally.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, SUM(l.qty) FROM fact_order_line l JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT o.location_id, SUM(l.qty) FROM src_fact_order_line l JOIN src_fact_order o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: avg_order_value_usd
metrics.label: Average order value (USD)
metrics.formula: SUM(order_total_cents) / COUNT(orders) / 100  (ratio of sums; NOT additive across sites: re-derive from numerator and denominator)
caveats: Ratio metric: never average the per-site values to get a total.
Uses the order header total, which the order_total_mismatch rule reconciles to the lines (mismatching orders are quarantined).
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, SUM(o.order_total_cents)/100.0/COUNT(*) FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT o.location_id, SUM(l.qty*l.unit_price_cents)/100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM src_fact_order_line l JOIN src_fact_order o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: Order lines per order
caveats: Generator draws 1-4 distinct items per order uniformly, so this is a property of the generator, not of guests.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, 1.0*COUNT(*)/COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_key) FROM fact_order_line l JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT o.location_id, 1.0*COUNT(*)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM src_fact_order_line l JOIN src_fact_order o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: food_share_of_sales
metrics.label: Food share of gross sales
caveats: Category from the SCD2 item version in effect on the order date.
Depends on placeholder prices.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN i.category='food' THEN l.gross_sales_cents END)/SUM(l.gross_sales_cents) FROM fact_order_line l JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) JOIN dim_menu_item i USING(item_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT o.location_id, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN m.category='food' THEN l.qty*l.unit_price_cents END)/SUM(l.qty*l.unit_price_cents) FROM src_fact_order_line l JOIN src_fact_order o USING(order_id) JOIN src_dim_menu_item m USING(item_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: gobi_attach_rate
metrics.label: Gobi (M04) attach rate
metrics.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT orders containing item_id M04) / COUNT(DISTINCT orders)
caveats: Spans BOTH SCD2 versions (Gobi Taco -> Mango Habanero Gobi); the internal id M04 is the legacy key.
Exposure to the dish is not modelled: this is not demand. In the generator every item is equally likely to be drawn.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, 1.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.item_id='M04' THEN l.order_key END)/COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_key) FROM fact_order_line l JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) JOIN dim_menu_item i USING(item_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT o.location_id, 1.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.item_id='M04' THEN o.order_id END)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM src_fact_order_line l JOIN src_fact_order o USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: theoretical_usage_kg
metrics.label: Theoretical ingredient usage (kg)
metrics.formula: SUM(qty * kg_per_unit) using the recipe of the item version in effect on the order date
caveats: Recipes are PLACEHOLDER planning inputs, not tested recipes.
Only ingredients in the lab recipe table are tracked (8 ingredients); curry leaf, crema, chile etc. are not.
Mixes kg of different ingredients: meaningful per ingredient, only a convenience in total.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, SUM(u.theoretical_qty) FROM fact_usage_daily u JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: contribution_margin_usd
metrics.label: Contribution margin (USD) [ASSUMPTION costs]
metrics.formula: gross sales - SUM(theoretical usage kg * assumed cost/kg) - SUM(sales * other_cost_pct[category]) - SUM(qty * fixed_unit_cost[category])
caveats: EVERY cost is an ASSUMPTION in analytics/config.py. This is an illustration of a margin calculation, NOT a NASHA margin.
Excludes labour, rent, waste cost, overhead, tax.
Ranking stability under +/-25% cost multipliers is tested and reported.
metrics.mart_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT site_key, SUM(gross_sales_cents)/100.0 AS sales FROM fact_order_line GROUP BY 1), ic AS (SELECT u.site_key, SUM(u.theoretical_qty*g.assumed_cost_per_kg) AS c FROM fact_usage_daily u JOIN dim_ingredient g USING(ingredient_key) GROUP BY 1), oc AS (SELECT l.site_key, SUM(l.gross_sales_cents/100.0*CASE i.category WHEN 'food' THEN {{OTHER_FOOD}} ELSE 0 END + l.qty*CASE i.category WHEN 'beer' THEN {{FIXED_BEER}} WHEN 'na' THEN {{FIXED_NA}} ELSE 0 END) AS c FROM fact_order_line l JOIN dim_menu_item i USING(item_key) GROUP BY 1) SELECT d.site_id, s.sales - ic.c - oc.c FROM s JOIN ic USING(site_key) JOIN oc USING(site_key) JOIN dim_site d USING(site_key) ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: logged_waste_rate
metrics.label: Logged waste rate
metrics.formula: SUM(logged waste kg) / SUM(theoretical usage kg)
caveats: Waste events are SIMULATED by analytics/synth.py with stated probabilities; the rate is a property of that simulation.
Unlogged shrink is excluded by definition and appears in count_variance_pct instead.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.qty),0) FROM fact_waste_adjustment w WHERE w.site_key=s.site_key AND w.adj_kind='LOGGED_WASTE') / (SELECT SUM(u.theoretical_qty) FROM fact_usage_daily u WHERE u.site_key=s.site_key) FROM dim_site s WHERE s.site_key<>0 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: count_variance_pct
metrics.label: Net count variance, % of expected
metrics.grain: site x ingredient x count date
metrics.formula: SUM(counted - expected) / SUM(expected) over snapshots with a previous count
caveats: Net of positive and negative variances; per-ingredient |variance| is the better exception signal.
Counts carry +/-3% simulated noise; the injected unlogged shrink (L03 goat) is a labelled truth.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.site_id, SUM(f.variance_qty)/SUM(f.expected_on_hand) FROM fact_inventory_snapshot f JOIN dim_site s USING(site_key) WHERE f.prev_date_key<>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: supplier_on_time_rate
metrics.label: Supplier on-time rate
metrics.formula: COUNT(received PO lines with received_date <= expected_date) / COUNT(received PO lines)
caveats: Delivery delays are SIMULATED with per-supplier probabilities (config.SUPPLIER_LATE_PROB); this is not supplier performance.
Open POs are excluded (right-censored), which flatters recent behaviour.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.days_late<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) FROM fact_po_line p JOIN dim_supplier s USING(supplier_key) WHERE p.status='RECEIVED' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: avg_actual_lead_time_days
metrics.label: Average actual lead time (days)
metrics.formula: AVG(received_date - order_date) over received PO lines
caveats: Planned lead times are lab planning inputs; actual = planned + simulated delay.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, AVG(julianday(r.date)-julianday(o.date)) FROM fact_po_line p JOIN dim_supplier s USING(supplier_key) JOIN dim_date o ON o.date_key=p.order_date_key JOIN dim_date r ON r.date_key=p.received_date_key WHERE p.status='RECEIVED' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: dq_quarantine_rate
metrics.label: Orders quarantined / raw orders
caveats: The injected defect volume (8 per type) is a generator parameter, so this rate is by construction, not an observation about real data quality.
metrics.mart_sql: SELECT 'ALL', 1.0 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order)*1.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_orders)
metrics.raw_sql: SELECT 'ALL', 1.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM src_quarantine WHERE tbl='orders')/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_orders)
